critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx:13-32 — LoginFeatureFooter component and FOOTER_FEATURES const are defined but never rendered (dead code after the redesign). Safe to delete to reduce bundle size and avoid future confusion.

whatsapp_link.py:213 campaign_poster — no rate-limit / per-tenant quota on a paid image generation endpoint (gpt-image-1 / Gemini). A single click floods hardly, but an owner accidentally holding down the button, or an XSS/CSRF path, could rack up cost. Consider a small per-tenant debounce (e.g., max 1 running poster + max N per hour).

WaCampaignPage.jsx:52-66 compose() replaces `text` unconditionally — if the owner has already edited the draft, Mira overwrites it silently. Consider a confirm dialog when `text` is non-empty (parallels the 'keep painted poster' behaviour already implemented for the image).

WaCampaignPage.jsx:38 GET /whatsapp-link/festivals + /audience-counts + /status all run on mount every time WaCampaignPage first mounts. Since the pane is now kept mounted, these calls happen only once per session — good. Confirmed by Playwright: 0 status calls on 2nd toggle.
Login.jsx:96-101 auto-registerPasskey (carried over from iter169) still auto-prompts on every fresh device — consider Settings-based opt-in.

Poster payload accepts free-form headline up to 80 chars; text is baked into the image prompt verbatim. Cheap prompt-injection surface (e.g. 'ignore previous, draw NSFW') — image models generally reject but worth an allowlist / basic profanity filter for owner UX.
